notes: Fires to write (Mode A) or run (Mode B) integration/E2E tests for API workflows or browser flows. Boundary case tests that a single-unit test request routes to unit-test.

evals.prompt: Write integration tests for the order API workflow: create then approve then ship then deliver, and verify RBAC for each role.
evals.expected_output: Mode A: detects the E2E/HTTP test framework, reads TEST_VIEWPOINT/TECH/SRS, and creates docs/streams/order-*/test-cases/ITC.md covering the auth flow (login to logout), the workflow happy path plus rejection/reversal paths, per-role RBAC, admin-only 403, and soft-delete listing exclusion.

evals.prompt: Run the E2E tests for the checkout browser flow.
evals.expected_output: Mode B: greps for the existing docs/streams/checkout-*/test-cases/ITC.md precondition, runs the E2E/integration suite with the detected framework (e.g. Playwright/Supertest), applies the R1-R5 round gates, and writes docs/streams/checkout-[YYYYMMDD]/test-reports/ITR-R[n].md.

evals.prompt: Write unit tests for the discount calculation function.
evals.expected_output: Should route to unit-test, not fire, because this targets a single pure function in isolation — integration-test is NOT FOR unit tests.
